description: This file defines a JSON Lines document loader class for loading and processing JSONL files, with support for dynamic metadata extraction, file handling, and document splitting.

classes.name: Jsonlines_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing a JSON Lines file loader with support for metadata extraction, file handling, and document splitting.

classes.name: TextLoader
classes.description: A class for loading text files or blobs and converting them into Document objects.

classes.name: JSONLinesLoader
classes.description: A subclass of TextLoader that parses JSONL formatted data, extracts content via a JSON pointer, and supports dynamic metadata.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the loader, reads files, splits documents if needed, and adds metadata.

methods.name: removeValuesStartingWithSlash
methods.description: Removes key-value pairs from an object where the value is a string starting with '/'.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the document(s) from file or blob, returning Document objects.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses raw JSONL string into an array of objects with pageContent and metadata, using a JSON pointer.
